# Validation Test Case 1: Basic Activity Execution

## Input
```json
{
  "templateId": "simple-feature-add",
  "variables": {
    "featureName": "test-validation-feature",
    "description": "Simple test feature for MCP data flow validation"
  },
  "reason": "Validate MCP data flow end-to-end",
  "expectedImpulseCount": 2,
  "expectedComponentCount": 3
}
```

## Expected Output
```json
{
  "pass": true,
  "results": {
    "activityExecution": {
      "exists": true,
      "hasCorrectTemplate": true,
      "hasMetrics": true,
      "hasImpulsesUsed": true,
      "hasComponentChanges": true,
      "impulsesUsedCount": 2,
      "componentsChangedCount": 3
    },
    "impulseUsage": {
      "recordsCreated": true,
      "recordCount": 2,
      "linkedToExecution": true
    },
    "impulseRegistry": {
      "updatedSuccessRates": true,
      "impulseCount": 2
    },
    "mcpPayload": {
      "captured": true,
      "hasImpulsesUsed": true,
      "hasComponentChanges": true
    }
  },
  "errors": []
}
```

## Test Description
Basic validation of MCP data flow with a simple activity template.
Expects 2 impulses to be loaded and 3 components to be changed.
Verifies complete data flow from activity execution through MCP to database storage.

## Success Criteria
- Activity created and executed successfully
- Impulses tracked in activity.impulses registry
- Component changes identified from git diff
- Data transmitted via MCP to CLI
- Backend stores impulse_usage and updates impulse_registry
- No errors in data flow
